name: Sertindole
summary: Sertindole, sold under the brand name Serdolect among others, is an antipsychotic medication. Sertindole was developed by the Danish pharmaceutical company Lundbeck and marketed under license by Abbott Labs. Like other atypical antipsychotics, it has activity at dopamine and serotonin receptors in the brain. It is used in the treatment of schizophrenia.

pharmacology.text: Like other atypical antipsychotics, it has activity at dopamine and serotonin receptors in the brain.

uses.text: Sertindole, sold under the brand name Serdolect among others, is an antipsychotic medication. Sertindole was developed by the Danish pharmaceutical company Lundbeck and marketed under license by Abbott Labs. It is used in the treatment of schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include a stuffy nose, dizziness, weight gain and reduced ejaculation. Its main serious risk is lengthening of the heart's QT interval, which can cause dangerous rhythm problems, so regular heart tracings are required.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括鼻塞、頭暈、體重增加和射精減少。它主要的嚴重風險是使心臟 QT 間期延長，可能造成危險的心律問題，因此需要定期做心電圖。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括鼻塞、头晕、体重增加和射精减少。它主要的严重风险是使心脏 QT 间期延长，可能造成危险的心律问题，因此需要定期做心电图。

fact.en: Sertindole was withdrawn voluntarily in 1998 over concerns about effects on heart rhythm, then allowed back in Europe with restrictions and heart monitoring.
fact.zh: Sertindole 在 1998 年因對心律的顧慮而自願下市，後來在歐洲附帶限制和心臟監測的條件下重新上市。
fact.zhHans: Sertindole 在 1998 年因对心律的顾虑而自愿下市，后来在欧洲附带限制和心脏监测的条件下重新上市。
